description: Credential get (Admin): the only gated read on the surface. confirm is asked ahead of validation, so every case carries it; the dry run reports the request without making it. Response is credential-bearing by design; only the request is pinned.

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This retrieves a stored Managed credential. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects non-positive credential_id
cases.expect_error: credential_id must be a positive integer
